name: Conditional Marketing Mailer for Woocommerce
author: wp-buy

sections.description:
Turn Abandoned Carts into Revenue with Smart Email Automation
Every day, potential customers leave your store without completing their purchase. With Conditional Marketing Mailer for WooCommerce, you can win them back and boost your sales effortlessly.

This powerful plugin allows you to create automated marketing emails triggered by custom conditions. From abandoned cart reminders to welcome emails and sales notifications, you have full control over what messages get sent, and when.

Each email (called a “notice”) can be customized, scheduled, and tracked—so you’ll always know what works best. Draft notices stay inactive until you publish them, ensuring you have time to fine-tune your campaigns.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Recover Lost Sales – Remind customers about their abandoned carts and encourage them to complete checkout.
  • Boost Engagement – Send automated welcome emails and personalized offers.
  • Simple Yet Powerful – Works right out of the box, no complex setup required.
  • Custom Conditions – Define rules to send the right message at the right time.
  • Track Performance – See open rates, link clicks, and subscriber engagement.
  • GDPR Ready – Fully compliant with privacy regulations.

Key Features

  • Build and send newsletters directly from WordPress
  • Create automatic emails triggered by customer actions
  • Send personalized welcome emails to new users
  • Increase WooCommerce sales with targeted marketing emails
  • Easy-to-use newsletter builder with shortcode support
  • Real-time tracking: monitor opens and clicks for every email
  • Flexible status options: save as draft or publish instantly
  • Zero configuration needed – start sending in minutes

With Conditional Marketing Mailer for WooCommerce, you’re not just sending emails—you’re building stronger customer relationships and driving more conversions.
